items.title: Register for the Jersey City payroll tax
items.authority: City of Jersey City Payroll Tax Unit
items.description: Employers with a Jersey City zip code register once, online, through the city's payment portal before they file. Employers with quarterly gross payroll under $2,500 are exempt, and so are the wages of Jersey City residents.
items.deadline: Before the first return is due

items.title: File and pay the Jersey City payroll tax
items.authority: City of Jersey City Payroll Tax Unit
items.description: Employers located in Jersey City pay a 1% tax on gross payroll, generally the amount reported on federal Form 941, and file each quarter. The tax cannot be deducted from employees' wages, and a postmark does not count as the payment date.

items.title: File Newark employer payroll tax returns
items.authority: City of Newark Department of Finance
items.description: Employers with payroll in Newark register with the city and file quarterly returns for the 1% employer payroll tax.

items.title: Hold a Paterson mercantile license
items.description: City ordinance requires businesses operating in Paterson to register and obtain a mercantile license; operating a business, trade or occupation without one is prohibited.

items.title: Hold a Trenton business license
items.description: Businesses with a permanent location or branch in Trenton in the Chapter 146 categories need an annual city license from the City Clerk, which also requires a current New Jersey business registration. The 2011 ordinance fee schedule sets $300 per location for merchants and retail sales and $500 for wholesalers and manufacturers; other categories differ, and the codified schedule may have been amended.
